mission.title: New mission
mission.description: Start a conversation with agent {agent} using your chosen LLM.
mission.resumeDescription: You can also resume the previous mission: the new LLM will read a summary and continue from there.
mission.resumeWithSummary: The new LLM will read a history summary to resume.
mission.resumeSameLlm: Resumes the previous mission's context on the same LLM.
mission.followupPlaceholder: E.g.: continue what we were doing, focus on X…

llm.handoverTail: Summary failed: only the END of the conversation crossed
llm.confirmWholeTitle: The new engine receives the entire conversation — nothing is lost.
llm.confirmCompactTitle: The conversation is summarised before crossing: shorter, but detail is lost.
llm.confirmTooLarge: too large for this engine's prompt — compaction is the only way across
llm.handoverSending: Handing the whole conversation over to {model}…
llm.handoverRunning: Handing the conversation over to {model} — preparing the context…
llm.handoverCompacted: Context COMPACTED into a summary — the new engine takes over from there.
llm.handoverNoContext: New session started, no prior context to transmit.
llm.confirmSameBackend: Same engine, other model: the session keeps running and nothing of the context is lost.
llm.confirmNewBackend: Another engine: the session is restarted and the conversation is handed over. The context crosses whole if it fits in the new prompt, otherwise it is COMPACTED into a summary — detail is lost.
llm.confirmPending: No conversation open yet: the pair applies to the first message.
llm.confirmTurnBlocked: A turn is running. Changing engine will be refused until it ends — stop it or wait.
llm.selfPermissionsHint: This agent manages its own permissions: no Allow/Deny card from TIMON.

account.reauthHint: This account must sign in again before it can run missions. Rooks never moves a mission to another subscription on its own.
account.cooldownHint: This account is out of quota for now. Pick it again once its window reopens.
account.unavailableHint: This account no longer exists or is no longer assigned to you: choose another one.
account.signedOutHint: Rooks found this provider's CLI but nobody is signed in to it: a mission sent to it would stop on "Not logged in". Sign in from {settingsPath}, or in a terminal.

llm.limitWorktree: work in Rooks's folder (no code or merge tasks)
llm.unverifiedHint: Written from the vendor's documentation: not checked against the real program.

roles.label: label
roles.directivesPlaceholder: You do X. You don't do Y…

feed.actionOnlyHint: List only the notifications waiting for you to act

picker.title: Missions of {agent}
picker.empty: No missions. Start a new one.

multichat.mobileHint: The parallel chat grid is not useful in mobile portrait. Open

templates.title: Templates
templates.empty: Save the agents on screen to bring them back in one click.

error.duplicate-name: A template already has that name.
error.too-many: Template limit reached: delete one first.
error.too-large: Too much to store: delete a template first.
error.empty-grid: Put at least one agent in the grid first.
error.write-failed: The template could not be saved. Try again.

slot.openMission: Open this mission in the chat

rail.label: Agents to place in the grid
rail.place: {name} — press Enter to add to the first empty cell
rail.hint: Drag {name} into a cell, or double-click to add it to the first empty one

search.label: Search agents by name, project, pole or team

missionEgress.noMission: No mission open: this view follows the conversation on screen.
missionEgress.newHostHint: First reached in its project by this mission: the alert named it.
missionEgress.status: HTTP status sent back to the program
missionEgress.empty: No connection journaled for this mission yet.
missionEgress.limit: Only programs that honour HTTP(S)_PROXY go through the journal. Those that ignore it, Node's built-in fetch among them, reach the network without appearing here.
missionEgress.offBody: This mission's connections are not recorded, so this view says nothing about what it reached. To enable the journal, set host.isolation.egress.mode to "log" in rooks.config.json, then restart Rooks.
missionEgress.offHistory: The connections below were recorded before it was turned off.
missionEgress.notListening: The outbound proxy is not running: connections made now are not journaled. The daemon log says why.
missionEgress.retention: Kept: the last {count} connections of the mission, {days} days at most.

error.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again to see this mission's network activity.
error.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to read missions.
error.not_found: This mission does not exist, or it belongs to another account.
error.unavailable: The network journal could not be read.

hint.working: Process alive, a turn is running.
hint.turn_done: Process alive, but the last turn is over — waiting for the next message.
hint.open: Mission still open, nothing running: no process, or no finished turn yet.

permissionRefusal.accountLacks: Your account does not hold {permission}. Ask an administrator to add it to your role.
permissionRefusal.generic: Your account is not allowed to do this.
